title: Despite pause, U.S. tariffs leave furniture, cabinet makers 'in dire straits': industry association
summary: The Canadian Kitchen Cabinet Association says while it welcomes U.S. President Donald Trump's postponement of tariff increases on furniture, cabinets and vanities that were set for Jan. 1, the industry is still being devastated by the existing duties.
